question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **only**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper meaning of these given words.
 
 
• **Singly **means one at a time; individually.
 
• **Only **means with no others existing or present.
 
• **Rarely **means on very few occasions; almost never.
 
• **Alone **means someone or something being in isolation or being unique.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words. "**only**" is the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **Only three of the world's poorest and most marginalised areas still have polio.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

Complete passage: *Polio was once a disease feared worldwide, striking suddenly and paralysing mainly children (1) for __life. WHO is a partner in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, the __(2) largest__ private-public partnership for health, which has __(3) reduced__ polio by 99%. Polio now survives **__(4) only __**among the world's three poorest and (5)________ marginalised communities, where it stalks the most (6)________ children. These are - Afghanistan, Nigeria and Pakistan. (7)_________ poliovirus transmission is interrupted in these countries, all (8)________ remain at risk of importation of polio, (9)________ vulnerable countries with weak public health and immunisation services. WHO's goal is (10)_______ every last child with polio vaccine and ensure a polio-free world for future generations.*
